- Manifest (seq 9): CNS-0301, a consumables container, recorded at landing_stand/slot_0, serviceable. It was the only consumables container on site, matching the objective.
- At the landing stand the wrist camera during the pick saw "a pale/gray logistics box with a T-shaped lifting collar/handle" standing on the offload stand — i.e. the item really was there, not just a manifest claim.
- After release at the habitat stand, a front-camera observation (seq 136, frame front_0000511.44) showed a pale rectangular box standing on the habitat_stand/slot_0 shelf with nothing else on that shelf.

WHAT WAS DONE
1. Queried work_stands for landing_stand/slot_0 (grasp height 1.017 m = 0.55 m place frame + 0.467 m catalogued handle), navigated to the feature, and docked at the reach pose (standoff 0). Base verified: position error 0.015 m, yaw error 0.001 rad (seq 32).
2. Picked the container by the slot between the T-handle's transverse head and the collar below, on support landing_stand/slot_0. Skill succeeded first try.
3. Queried work_stands for habitat_stand/slot_0, navigated to the feature and docked at the reach pose (standoff 0). Base verified: position error 0.021 m, yaw error 0.0 rad (seq 86); payload still held on both legs (seq 73, 85).
4. Placed the container on habitat_stand/slot_0 with release_constraint below_overhang, per the catalogue's release constraint for this handle.
5. Stowed the arm and drove back to the dock: navigate_to_pose (4.0, 19.3) then (0,0,0), closed with dock_to_pose onto (0,0,0).

VERIFIED EFFECTS
- item_held (seq 54, holds=true): jaw 0.172 rad holding_object, lift 0.148 m, rose_with_gripper=true, median image flow on the item 0.3 px vs 477.8 px for the vacated stand. Interface fit agreement 0.812 with residual 0.0 m over 621 depth points.
- item_still_held (seq 73 and 85, holds=true) across both drive legs; jaw 0.183 / 0.170 rad, vision model saw the held payload (descriptions "rectangular block", "metal bar" are consistent with the jaws clamped on the handle head filling the wrist frame).
- item_placed (seq 102): jaws open at 0.82 rad, released 5.4 mm above the expected support point, tool 0.236 m clear of the release point, post-retreat image flow 0.03 px (item still), 0 depth points between the open fingers. holds=null only because the container fell outside the wrist settle view — this gap was closed by the positive front-camera sighting (seq 136) above.
- arm_stowed (seq 120, holds=true); current arm posture stowed, jaws open (0.82 rad).
- base_at_commanded_pose at the dock (seq 158, holds=true): position error 0.012 m, yaw error 0.002 rad; current base estimate (-0.0085, -0.008, -0.0022) in map, i.e. the rover dock at (0,0,0).

UNRESOLVED / NOTES
- No failures, guard denials, refusals or anomalies occurred; no mission-control authorization was needed (no work on an energized unit's equipment bay).
- The only soft spot in the evidence chain is that the placement's own settle view did not frame the item (item_placed holds=null); the delivery is instead supported by the release kinematics/jaw/flow measurements plus the independent front-camera sighting of exactly one pale box on the habitat stand shelf.
- The manifest's recorded location for CNS-0301 (landing_stand/slot_0) is now stale; its actual location is habitat_stand/slot_0. I have no capability to write back to the logistics record, so please update mission control's inventory.
- Link was up throughout (Earth sets in ~338 s at report time).
